provider_model: Google AI Pro account / Antigravity CLI
method_definition: Gemini 3.1 Pro High through the Google AI Pro account subscription generated Blender Python scene code for Table 2; retained final Blender meshes are reused for Table 3 without another model request

structural_metrics.reason: The frozen final output has meshes and descriptive Blender node names but no stable independent-instance graph, unified object roles, or native support edges.

pilot.acceptance_note: Both reviewed plots use the registered ROI and spawn convention. All 13 reusable pilot meshes reached terminal navigation evaluation and all seven unavailable Table-2 slots were retained as ITT zeros.

reuse.eligible: frozen Gemini identity, Google AI Pro account auth, generation_success=true, build_success=true, retained scene.blend, and SUCCESS marker

coordinate_system: Blender meters, Z up, evaluation region centered at X=Y=0

navigation.aggregation: mean over the four seeds inside each specification, then mean over 25 specifications

blender.gpu_reason: Canonical mesh export performs no rendering or neural inference; Blender dependency-graph and Recast operations are CPU-only

python_environment.purpose: Existing Python 3.11 environment for NumPy and the frozen Recast extension; no downloads required

billing: No Table-3 model request; only retained Table-2 artifacts are read

amendments.stage: after the first formal export attempt and before aggregation or reporting
amendments.reason: Four reusable Urban Blender files had no upward triangles selected by the frozen pedestrian-surface rules. One reusable Indoor file produced selected reference triangles but no connected Recast component after the frozen agent-radius erosion.
amendments.effect: Apply the already-frozen unusable-final-geometry ITT policy. Source eligibility remains 78 Indoor and 76 Urban; Table-3 coverage becomes 77 evaluated plus 23 ITT Indoor and 72 evaluated plus 28 ITT Urban. No model, scene, selection rule, threshold, navigation formula, or aggregate value was changed after observation.
